quests.title: Welcome to GregGuns
quests.desc: Guns here follow GregTech progression: each weapon needs a machine tier and a gate material. This tab walks you up the tiers.

quests.title: Fire, Reload, Zoom
quests.desc: Hold use to fire, press the reload key to swap magazines, right-click to zoom. Rebind keys in Controls.

quests.title: Ammo and Magazines
quests.desc: Each gun takes one caliber. Loose rounds fill a magazine; sneak-click a magazine to empty it.

quests.title: Where Gear Comes From
quests.desc: Craft it in GT machines, or find it: quest loot bags, chests in ruins, drops from hostile soldiers. NEI lists every recipe and drop.

quests.title: Reading a Tier
quests.desc: An LV item needs an LV machine and steel, an MV item needs aluminum, and so on. Tooltips show the tier.

quests.title: Steam-Age Arms
quests.desc: Bronze and wrought iron are enough for a first firearm. No electricity needed.

quests.title: Hand Cannon
quests.desc: A single-shot bronze and wrought-iron cannon. Slow and loud.

quests.title: Stone Bullets
quests.desc: Cobblestone and gunpowder at a crafting table. Your first lesson in ammo supply.

quests.title: First Blood
quests.desc: Shoot five zombies with the Hand Cannon. Reload between shots.

quests.title: T1 Scout Armor
quests.desc: Light armor. Each piece adds to your armor value; read the tooltips.

quests.title: T1 Miner Armor
quests.desc: Miner set, crafted from bronze plate and wrought iron.

quests.title: Steam Age Done
quests.desc: Steel is next. Make it in a GT furnace setup, then open the LV chapter.

quests.title: Steel-Age Firearms
quests.desc: LV opens steel guns. The last step of each recipe is an LV machine.

quests.title: Ammo Press
quests.desc: Ammo is made in the GregGuns Ammo Press, not in a GT Assembler. Build the LV press: it has its own recipe list in NEI.

quests.title: 9mm Rounds
quests.desc: The Ammo Press builds 9mm rounds from a GT round, a foil casing and gunpowder. Check the Ammo Press tab in NEI.

quests.title: 9mm Pistol
quests.desc: Your first real sidearm. Magazine-fed.

quests.title: Magazines
quests.desc: Empty and filled magazines are Ammo Press recipes too. Sneak-click a magazine to empty it.

quests.title: Revolver
quests.desc: A heavier sidearm. Compare its damage with the pistol on the tooltip.

quests.title: Sawed Off
quests.desc: Spread pellets: strong at point-blank range, weak far away. Uses shotgun shells.

quests.title: Bolt Action Rifle
quests.desc: Long range and slow to cycle. Right-click to zoom.

quests.title: Knife or Crowbar
quests.desc: Melee tools never run dry.

quests.title: T1 Combat Armor
quests.desc: Steel plate pressed in the LV Assembler.

quests.title: Steel Age Done
quests.desc: MV needs aluminum and a bigger power setup. Move on when your GT line gets there.

quests.title: Aluminum-Age Arms
quests.desc: MV adds automatic weapons, grenades and second-tier armor. Aluminum is the gate.

quests.title: SMG Magazines
quests.desc: Press an empty magazine in the Ammo Press, then fill it with rounds.

quests.title: Thompson SMG
quests.desc: Fast, light automatic fire at MV.

quests.title: M4 or AK47
quests.desc: Assault rifles use their own magazines, not SMG magazines.

quests.title: Combat Shotgun
quests.desc: Magazine-fed shotgun. Uses the same shells as the Sawed Off.

quests.title: Akimbo
quests.desc: A matching pistol in each hand. Needs the offhand slot.

quests.title: Frag Grenade
quests.desc: Explosives need TNT dust from the GT line. Throw from a safe distance.

quests.title: Flashbang
quests.desc: Blinds and stuns instead of killing. Useful for clearing a camp.

quests.title: T2 Armor
quests.desc: Combat, Commando or Riot. Pick the set that suits your style.

quests.title: Aluminum Age Done
quests.desc: HV brings heavy weapons and stainless steel.

quests.title: Heavy Arms
quests.desc: HV adds heavy weapons, launchers and electric tools. Stainless steel is the gate.

quests.title: AUG, SCAR or Vector
quests.desc: Specialist rifles. Pick one; they are all HV builds.

quests.title: LMG
quests.desc: Belt-fed and heavy. LMG magazines are an HV part.

quests.title: AS50
quests.desc: Anti-materiel rifle with its own magazines.

quests.title: Grenade Launcher
quests.desc: Fires the 40 mm grenades you learned to make at MV.

quests.title: Rocket Launcher
quests.desc: Rockets need explosive dust and a circuit. Mind your own blast radius.

quests.title: Flamethrower
quests.desc: Burns GT fuel from a fuel tank. Diesel works.

quests.title: Chainsaw and Power Hammer
quests.desc: Electric tools charge only in a charger or battery buffer of exactly their tier: HV.

quests.title: Heavy Arms Done
quests.desc: EV brings energy weapons.

quests.title: Energy Weapons
quests.desc: EV adds lasers, pulse rifles and electric ammo. Titanium is the gate.

quests.title: Laser Focus
quests.desc: The Laser Focus is cut in a GT Laser Engraver at EV. It is the core of every laser weapon.

quests.title: Laser Rifle
quests.desc: Electric, so it charges at an EV battery buffer. An HV buffer will not accept it.

quests.title: Pulse Rifle or PDW
quests.desc: Advanced magazines are the EV ammo step up.

quests.title: Minigun
quests.desc: Drum-fed, very high fire rate. Heavy on ammo.

quests.title: Tesla or Sonic Rifle
quests.desc: Specialist weapons. Pick one.

quests.title: T3 Combat Armor
quests.desc: Titanium plate in the EV Assembler.

quests.title: Steam Armor
quests.desc: Bronze plate and cloth around a coal-fired chestplate. Burn Coal or Charcoal for speed and strength.

quests.title: Energy Weapons Done
quests.desc: IV brings blasters and power armor.

quests.title: E. coli Culture
quests.desc: The Bio Gun runs on culture fluid. Brew Biomass, make the E. coli dish in the Bio Lab, then grow the culture in the BartWorks Bacterial Vat.

quests.title: Bio Tank
quests.desc: The Bio Tank is built from a GT Large Fluid Cell. A Fluid Canner fills it with E. coli culture fluid.

quests.title: Bio Gun
quests.desc: Sprays culture fluid that eats flesh. Refill it from the Bio Tank. The Nether Blaster later shares this chain.

quests.title: Power Armor Era
quests.desc: IV adds blasters, power armor and the anti-grav device. Tungstensteel is the gate.

quests.title: Blaster Rifle
quests.desc: High-damage energy rifle at IV voltage.

quests.title: De-Atomizer Pistol
quests.desc: One pistol or two; the akimbo pair needs the offhand slot.

quests.title: Scatter Laser Rifle
quests.desc: A shotgun-style laser. Short range, wide spread.

quests.title: Golden Revolver
quests.desc: A showpiece sidearm. Single or akimbo.

quests.title: Power Armor
quests.desc: Full powered suit. Charge it at an IV buffer.

quests.title: Exo Suit
quests.desc: Strength and carry bonuses.

quests.title: Anti-Gravity Device
quests.desc: Back device for flight. Needs the wings slot.

quests.title: Power Armor Era Done
quests.desc: LuV recipes use the Assembly Line.

quests.title: Assembly-Line Weapons
quests.desc: LuV weapons are built in the Assembly Line with a research item, like GT's own LuV parts.

quests.title: Nether Charge
quests.desc: The explosive behind the Nether Blaster.

quests.title: Nether Blaster
quests.desc: Fires nether charges. Mind the splash.

quests.title: Alien Blaster
quests.desc: LuV energy weapon.

quests.title: Grim Reaper
quests.desc: Late-game close-range weapon.

quests.title: LuV Arms Done
quests.desc: ZPM is the top of the GregGuns tree.

quests.title: Nuclear Arms
quests.desc: ZPM weapons use nuclear cells. Naquadah is the gate.

quests.title: Nuclear Power Cell
quests.desc: Uranium-based power cell. Store it carefully.

quests.title: Nuclear Death Ray
quests.desc: The top energy weapon.

quests.title: Nuke Launcher
quests.desc: Fires tactical nuke rockets. Do not use near your base.

quests.title: Top of the Tree
quests.desc: You have built everything GregGuns offers.

quests.title: Hostile Factions
quests.desc: Soldiers, bandits and zombies roam the Overworld. Some carry guns; some drop ammo.

quests.title: Walking Dead
quests.desc: Hunt the zombie variants: soldiers, farmers and miners.

quests.title: Skeleton Soldiers
quests.desc: Armed skeletons shoot back. Use cover.

quests.title: Bandits and Outcasts
quests.desc: Raiders carry LV gear. Expect 9mm drops.

quests.title: Psycho Steve
quests.desc: A chainsaw mini-boss. His drop is tier-legal for the Overworld, not an HV saw.

quests.title: Army Soldiers
quests.desc: Disciplined and well armed. They carry MV ammunition.

quests.title: Commandos and Stormtroopers
quests.desc: Elite soldiers. Armor up first.

quests.title: Attack Helicopter
quests.desc: A flying boss with its own health bar. Bring launchers.

quests.title: Elite Variants
quests.desc: Kill one elite Infernal mob: up to five modifiers, glowing name. Tick the box when you have.

quests.title: Ultra Variants
quests.desc: Kill one ultra Infernal mob. Ultra drops are MV.

quests.title: Infernal Variants
quests.desc: Kill one infernal-rank mob. It can drop rare HV items.

quests.title: Dictator Dave
quests.desc: A secret mini-boss with a Golden Revolver. Appears only from spawn eggs or the pack's own spawner setup.

quests.title: Cyberdemon
quests.desc: A config-gated late boss. No natural spawn.

quests.title: Alien Bug
quests.desc: A config-gated boss from the bug nest.

quests.title: Ruins and Camps
quests.desc: Natural structures dot the Overworld: factories, houses, bunkers, camps and ships. Their chests hold tiered gear.

quests.title: Small Ruins
quests.desc: Factory building, train station, medium house and gas station. Their chests hold LV gear.

quests.title: Dungeon Weapons
quests.desc: Roguelike dungeons drop weapons by depth: LV near the surface, MV deeper.

quests.title: Big Bunker
quests.desc: Reinforced chests and soldiers. MV ceiling.

quests.title: Military Camp
quests.desc: Tents, barracks and a flag. Many soldiers.

quests.title: Carrier and Submarine
quests.desc: Large structures with MV weapon chests.

quests.title: GregGuns Machines
quests.desc: Most machines are plain GT. Only the Repair Bench and the Turret are GregGuns' own.

quests.title: Repair Bench
quests.desc: Mends guns and armor using the item's gate material. Tier is provisional (MV) until area 09 settles it.

quests.title: Mending a Weapon
quests.desc: Put a damaged gun and its gate material in the bench.

quests.title: Turret
quests.desc: Automatic defense. Tier is provisional (HV) until area 09 settles it.

quests.title: Friend or Foe
quests.desc: Turrets spare you and your allies on a GTNHLib team, and shoot hostiles.

quests.title: Powering the Turret
quests.desc: The turret takes EU at its tier. Overvoltage damages it.

quests.title: Armory Gantry
quests.desc: The Gantry is a multiblock repair hall with a row of bays, for armor and guns in bulk. Its controller is HV and it needs an interior lamp.

quests.title: Equipment Slots
quests.desc: Armor uses armor slots. Goggles, packs and pouches use Baubles slots.

quests.title: Medkit
quests.desc: Heals you over time. Craft one before a fight.

quests.title: Gas Mask
quests.desc: A helmet-slot mask. GT hazards check armor slots only.

quests.title: Know Your Hazards
quests.desc: Each protective item lists the hazards it blocks. Check the tooltip.

quests.title: Night Vision Goggles
quests.desc: Wear in the head Baubles slot, not the helmet slot.

quests.title: Ammo Pouch
quests.desc: Wear in the quiver Baubles slot.

quests.title: Oxygen Mask and Tanks
quests.desc: For space and bad air. Needs compressed air.

quests.title: Jump Pack
quests.desc: Back device in the wings slot.

quests.title: Glider
quests.desc: Glide down from heights. Also in the wings slot.

quests.title: Ammo Logistics
quests.desc: Ammo is the real cost of a gun. Build it as production, not as crafting.

quests.title: Run the Press
quests.desc: The Ammo Press makes rounds in bulk. Feed it GT parts and powder, and take the shells from its output.

quests.title: Magazines in the Press
quests.desc: The same press makes empty magazines and fills them, so one machine covers the whole chain.

quests.title: Pipe It
quests.desc: Move rounds and parts between machines with GT item pipes, so the line runs unattended.

quests.title: Ammo Depot
quests.desc: Stock 256 rounds in a chest: your own supply.

quests.title: Explosives Handling
quests.desc: Grenades and rockets need explosive dust. Store it away from the line.

quests.title: Charging at the Right Tier
quests.desc: A GregGuns electric item has one tier. Only a charger or buffer of exactly that tier takes it.

quests.title: Fuel Tanks
quests.desc: Fuel tanks hold GT fuel. Diesel from the oil line works.

quests.title: Advanced Ammunition
quests.desc: EV ammo: advanced magazines and minigun drums.

quests.title: Ammunition Works
quests.desc: The Ammunition Works is a multiblock press hall with high parallels. Build it when one press cannot keep up. It needs an interior lamp.

quests.title: Filling Bench (optional)
quests.desc: An optional annex behind the packing end of the Works, built around six workbench tables. It loads magazines from the Works output.

quests.title: Your First Warhead
quests.desc: A warhead is a GregTech-built charge: a stainless steel casing around TNT and a payload. The starter recipe in the Assembler makes a Condensed warhead with a fill of 1 from 2 stainless steel plates, 2 TNT and a Fuze Assembly Mk I. Make one and keep it.

quests.title: Demolition Charge
quests.desc: Place a warhead where you want the hole and light it with Flint and Steel, a Fire Charge or a redstone pulse. The fuse is 3 seconds plus 1 second per 3 blocks of blast radius, so a full Condensed warhead gives you 6. Get well clear, and keep other charges away: another explosion sets one off in half a second.

quests.title: Titanium Casing
quests.desc: The Tier 2 casing is made of titanium and holds up to 20 charges, four times the 5 charges of the Tier 1 casing. Its blast types are made in the Assembler at EV, from eight titanium plates, Industrial TNT, Plastic Explosive and a Fuze Assembly Mk II. Make a Tier 2 warhead.

quests.title: Missile Chip
quests.desc: Every missile starts as a chip. The GregTech Circuit Assembler makes a Missile Chip T1 at HV from an Advanced Plastic Circuit Board, 2 Advanced circuits and 4 fine gold wire. The Tier 2 chip is made at EV from an Advanced Epoxy Circuit Board, 2 Data circuits and 4 fine electrum wire. Make a Tier 1 chip.

quests.title: Engrave the Schematic
quests.desc: Put the chip and a Red lens (Tier 2: Blue) in the Laser Engraver. The lens is not used up. Slot the finished Missile Schematic into the Galacticraft NASA Workbench to open the missile's page.

quests.title: Missile Body
quests.desc: On the NASA Workbench page, build a Missile Body T1: three compressed steel plates in one column, four Galacticraft Tier 1 rocket fins, a Galacticraft Tier 1 engine and a Guidance Computer Mk I. Compressed plates come from the Implosion Compressor. There is no warhead slot; the warhead goes on at the pad. A better Guidance Computer makes the missile land closer.

quests.title: Stack It on the Pad
quests.desc: Place the Missile Body on the middle of a Galacticraft Launch Pad, then set a warhead on its nose; it seats flush. Sneak and right-click the body with an empty hand to arm it, which turns the stack into a missile.

quests.title: Fuel the Missile
quests.desc: Attach a Galacticraft Fuel Loader to the pad. A Tier 1 missile takes 2,000 mB of RP-1 or Cetane-Boosted Diesel, or better. Fuel left unburned at impact makes the blast up to 25 percent bigger, so a closer target hits harder.

quests.title: Launch Control
quests.desc: Place a Launch Control block within 4 blocks of the pad and power it at HV. Type the target X and Z, or load them from a Data Stick. The screen shows the range (at least 20 blocks, at most 1,000 for Tier 1) and the blast radius to expect.

quests.title: First Launch
quests.desc: Press Launch, or send the block a redstone pulse. After two seconds of warm-up the missile climbs, flies its arc and detonates on impact; a Tier 1 flight at full range takes about a minute. The pad, the fuel loader and the Launch Control come through unharmed. Make sure nobody stands at the target.

quests.title: Tier 2 Missile
quests.desc: Tier 2 flies up to 3,000 blocks and carries a titanium-cased warhead. Its chip is made at EV, its body takes six titanium plates, and it burns 4,000 mB of Dense Hydrazine or better. Build it, fuel it and launch it.

quests.title: Missile Silo
quests.desc: Missiles launch from the Missile Silo, a 5 by 5 tower you build from Gantry Casing and glass around an open 3 by 3 shaft, with a Galacticraft Launch Pad for its floor and a ring of Gantry Beams on top. The controller is an HV machine, and the Energy Hatch sets what it launches: HV for Tier 1, EV for Tier 2, LuV for Tier 3. A silo shot flies 25% farther and scatters half as much. Fit an Input Bus for bodies and warheads, an Input Hatch for fuel, an Energy Hatch and a Maintenance Hatch in place of glass panes in the three rings above the floor, or in the floor's outer ring. Feed it a body and a warhead and it stands the missile in the shaft for you. Build the silo and put a Launch Control within 6 blocks of it.

quests.title: Nuclear Warhead
quests.desc: The nuclear warhead is a Tier 3 casing at ZPM, two blocks tall, made in the Assembler from tungstensteel plates, Industrial TNT, Plastic Explosive, uranium-235, plutonium and a Fuze Assembly Mk III. It flies only on a Tier 3 missile from the silo. A full warhead blasts 64 blocks, and nothing living inside the inner 60 percent (38 blocks at full fill) survives, bosses included. The top layer of ground is left irradiated for about an hour: cross it in full hazmat armor. Launch one from your silo, and stand well back.

quests.title: Automate the Body
quests.desc: Scan one hand-built body into a Data Stick in the Scanner, then the Assembly Line builds the basic body from plates, fins, an engine, 2 circuits (Advanced for Tier 1, Data for Tier 2) and 250 L of lubricant: 30 seconds for Tier 1, 45 for Tier 2. A better Guidance Computer is fitted afterwards in the Assembler: put the body and the computer in, and the same body comes out with that guidance.
